name: HC34a: Maintained on current regimen
description:
Number of active ART clients who entered the non-suppressed workflow, underwent HIV drug-resistance testing, received an HIVDR result, and were subsequently maintained on their ART regimen during the reporting period.
 The client must have a previous valid non-suppressed VL, hivdr_sample_collected = 'Yes', evidence that HIVDR results were returned, a clinical decision date within the reporting period, an ETL outcome of Suppressed & Maintained, and must satisfy the active-on-ART rule. The outcome represents the post-IAC/HIVDR clinical disposition documented by the form. The form explicitly defines this outcome category.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT n.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_non_suppressed_card n
WHERE n.patient_id IS NOT NULL

  /* HIVDR test completed / result returned */
  AND n.hivdr_sample_collected = 'Yes'
  AND (
      n.hivdr_results IS NOT NULL
      OR n.date_hivr_results_recieved_at_facility IS NOT NULL
  )

  /* Clinical outcome recorded during reporting period */
  AND n.date_of_decision >= :startDate
  AND n.date_of_decision < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

  /* Maintained on regimen */
  AND n.outcome = 'Suppressed & Maintained'

  /* Prior valid non-suppressed VL */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0
        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= n.date_of_decision
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = n.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
